value.rationale: The identifying-code polynomial is a natural complete enumerator of single-fault sensor sets on the classically symmetric 16-vertex cubic incidence graph, not an arbitrary slice; the 584 optimal placements split into 13 inequivalent symmetry classes and yield a structural bipartition distribution. Both the exact minimum and all higher coefficients are derived reproducibly, providing meaningful finite classification not implied by mere code existence or graph properties.
